title: 善友与听法

evidence.pali: ‘‘Kalyāṇamittassetaṃ , meghiya, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa yaṃ sīlavā bhavissati, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissati, ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhissati sikkhāpadesu.
evidence.chinese_simplified: ‘梅吉亚，对于有善友、善伴、善亲近者的比丘，可以期待的是：他将具足戒德，住于守护波罗提木叉律仪，具足正行与行处，于微细过失中见其危险，受持诸学处而修学。’
evidence.english: Meghiya, this is to be expected of a bhikkhu who has good friends, good companions, and good intimates: that he will be virtuous, will dwell restrained by the restraint of the Pātimokkha, will be accomplished in conduct and resort, will see danger in the slightest faults, and, having undertaken the training rules, will train in them.

isolation_reason: 旧图保留的独立概念有直接 V4 逐句证据，但当前闭包没有足够直接的关系句将其连接到另一发布节点；为避免凭概念相似度补边，保留为可检索、可引用的独立节点。
